name: Delete Field Extractor
description: Delete Field Extractor Deletes all custom extraction rules for an extractor type. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/field_extractors/{extractor}

name: Get Field Extractor
description: Get Field Extractor Retrieves the custom extraction rules configured for a given extractor type. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/field_extractors/{extractor}

name: Update Field Extractor
description: Update Field Extractor Replaces all custom extraction rules for an extractor type. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/field_extractors/{extractor}
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/field_extractors/{extractor}
Replaces all custom extraction rules for an extractor type. Omitted rules are deleted.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.; extractor (path) — Extractor type.
Optional: body (body) — Desired-state replacement of all rules for this extractor type.
